basics.name: Jose Navarro
basics.label: Systems Engineering Student — Backend Engineering (Java/Spring) - Microsoft Student Ambassadors
basics.summary: Systems Engineering student with over 3 years of experience building backend software in Java and the Spring ecosystem. I design and implement distributed systems — from architecture and requirements specification to consuming external services, integrating APIs, and asynchronous communication with Kafka. Experience deploying to AWS, securing identity with Keycloak, and applying SOLID principles, design patterns, and ISO/IEC standards on real projects. Currently exploring Spring AI and gRPC for high-performance systems.

work.name: Parsons - Kinetics
highlights: Implemented a wind energy estimation system consuming the external Open Meteo API with Python and Django.
Built an automated ETL pipeline with geospatial queries, using NumPy and Pandas for statistical analysis.
Architected a RESTful API with Django REST Framework for real-time estimations backed by the Django ORM.
Implemented a data-visualization module with Matplotlib and Seaborn for energy production reports.

work.name: RecyOps
work.summary: Plastic waste management system with a multi-tenant Spring Boot backend, from requirements specification through production implementation.
highlights: Developed the multi-tenant backend in Spring Boot 3 with schema-based data isolation in PostgreSQL (Hibernate + Flyway), enabling automatic onboarding of new companies.
Implemented authentication and authorization with JWT (OAuth2/Supabase) and role-based access control.
Built the service-layer unit test suite with JUnit 5 and Mockito, measuring coverage with JaCoCo.
Set up system observability with Prometheus/Grafana and asynchronous logging (Log4j2) for business-operation traceability.
Led requirements analysis (ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148) and architecture design (UML, E-R model), applying quality criteria from ISO/IEC 25010 and IEEE 29119-3.

work.name: Ecosistema Java - SpringFramework
highlights: Designed and implemented REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs with Spring Web, Spring GraphQL, and Spring WS, exposing backend services to multiple clients. Integrated AI capabilities into backend applications using Spring AI. Integrated legacy systems and consumed external services via SOAP and WSDL contracts. Prototyped high-performance communication between microservices using gRPC with Spring. Used the AWS SDK for Java to integrate storage (S3), asynchronous messaging (SQS/SNS), and compute (Lambda, EC2) into backend applications.
